analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($75.84) vs SMA5/20/50 ($87.91/$90.46/$90.15) — Below short-term and mid-term moving averages, indicating a weak position.
· Position relative to SMA100/200 ($80.17/$67.23) — Below mid-to-long-term moving averages, signaling a weakening mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (47.3%) + Current price range near historical midpoint.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (38.5→38.3) — Oversold condition persists, weak rebound signal.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.6841→-0.6841) — Bearish trend continues, no trend reversal signal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (Lower band $79.02) — Approaching the lower band, potential for further decline.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($76.34) — Based on 20-day low, need to confirm downside rigidity.
· Swing resistance ($82.52) — Based on 5-day high, short-term rebound expected upon breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Not Higher Low, Not Lower High) — Potential entry into a sideways range.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (1.67x) — Surge, indicating selling pressure during the downtrend.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase) — Observe if further decline, confirm rebound timing.
